SSC CGL 2024 Final Result/ Final Answer Key/ Marks

Post Date: March 18, 2025

7:08 pm

Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the Final Answer Key / Marks on its official website for the recruitment of Combined Graduate Level Examination. This recruitment is for 18,174 positions. The SSC application forms were filled out from June 24, 2024, to July 27, 2024. The CGL exam is scheduled to be conducted from January 18-20, 2025. Candidates can check the final answer key / marks by logging into the portal using their enrollment number, registration number, or date of birth.

SSC CGL Examination 2024 : Short Details

Important Dates

  • Application Begin : 24 June 2024
  • Last Date for Apply Online : 27 July 2024
  • Last Date Pay Exam Fee : 28 July 2024
  • Correction / Modified Form : 10-11 August 2024
  • Exam Date : 09 – 26 September 2024
  • Admit Card Available : September 2024
  • Answer Key : 06 – 08 October 2024
  • Result Date : Declared 
  • Tier I Marks Available : 16 December 2024
  • Tier-II Exam Date : 18th – 20th January 2025
  • Tier-II Exam City : 09 January 2025
  • Admit Card Date : 14 January 2025
  • Result Declared Date : 12 March 2025
  • Tier-II Final Answer Key / Marks : 18 March – 17 April 2025 

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : 100/- Rs
  • SC / ST : 0/- Rs
  • Online payment methods include:
    1. Debit Card – Use your bank debit card for payments.
    2. Credit Card – Pay using your credit card.
    3. Internet Banking – Directly transfer funds through your bank’s online portal.
    4. IMPS (Immediate Payment Service) – A quick bank transfer service available 24/7.
    5. Cash Card / Mobile Wallet – Pay using mobile wallets or pre-loaded cash cards.
SSC CGL Notification 2024 : Age Limits As On 01 October 2024
  • Minimum Age Required : 18 years
  • Maximum Age Required : 27-32 years
  • Age relaxations as per the rules mentioned on ssc notification

SSC CGL 2024 Vacancy Details
 Education Qualification 
Post Name Eligibility
Junior Statistical Officer
  • All candidates who have completed a Bachelor’s degree in any stream from a recognized university in India and meet one of the following criteria are eligible to apply for this recruitment:
    1. Scored 60 marks in Mathematics at the 10+2 (Intermediate) level, OR
    2. Studied Statistics as a subject in their degree course.
Statistical Investigator Grade-II
  • All candidates who have passed a Bachelor’s degree in any subject with Statistics as a subject from a recognized university in India are eligible to apply for this recruitment.
Research Assistant in National Human Rights Commission (NHRC)
  • All candidates who have completed a Bachelor’s degree in any stream from a recognized university in India are eligible to apply for this recruitment.
All other Posts
  • All candidates who have graduated in any stream from a recognized university in India are eligible to apply for this recruitment.

 

  • You May Also Check : ITBP Telecom SI, HC & Constable Online Form 2024

 

 How To Apply for SSC CGL Online Form 2024 
  • Interested candidates who wish to apply for the SSC CGL posts can submit their applications online either through the link provided below or directly on the official SSC CGL website. The last date to apply is 27th July 2024.

 

 Mode Of Selection 
  • CBT Exam (सीबीटी परीक्षा)
  • Interview (साक्षात्कार)
  • Document Verification (दस्तावेज़ सत्यापन)
  • Medical Examination (चिकित्सा परीक्षण)

The cutoff marks for the CBT (Computer-Based Test) Tier I are set according to different reservation categories, ensuring fair representation.

Cutoff Marks for SSC CGL Tier I (Category-Wise):

The cutoff marks for the SSC CGL CBT (Computer-Based Test) Tier I are set according to different reservation categories :

  • General Category: 30% (60 marks out of 200)
  • OBC and EWS (Economically Weaker Section): 25% (50 marks out of 200)
  • SC/ST (Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe): 20% (40 marks out of 200)

 

 How to Check & Download SSC CGL 2024 Final Result/ Final Answer Key/ Marks 
 

      • Visit the Official SSC Website: Navigate to 

      • Access the Results Section: On the homepage, click on the ‘Results’ tab.​

      • Select ‘CGL’ Examination: Within the Results section, choose the ‘CGL’ tab to view relevant notifications.​

      • Find the Final Result Link: Look for the link titled ‘Combined Graduate Level Examination, 2024 – Declaration of Final Result’ and click on it.

      • Download the Result PDF: A PDF document will open, listing the roll numbers of successful candidates. Use the search function (Ctrl + F) to locate your roll number.​

      2. Accessing and Downloading the Final Answer Key:

      • Navigate to the Answer Key Section: On the SSC homepage, click on the ‘Answer Key’ 

      • Locate the CGL 2024 Answer Key Notification: Find and click on the notification titled ‘Combined Graduate Level Examination, 2024 – Uploading of Final Answer Keys along with Question Paper(s) cum Response Sheet(s)’.​Staff Selection Commission

      • Download the Answer Key: The notification will contain a link to access the final answer keys. Click on this link, log in using your credentials (Roll Number and Password), and download your response sheet along with the final answer key.

      3. Viewing and Downloading Individual Marks:

      • Access the Marks Section: On the SSC website, click on the ‘Marks’ tab.​

      • Select the CGL 2024 Marks Link: Look for the link that reads ‘Combined Graduate Level Examination, 2024 – Candidates’ Marks’.​

      • Log In to Your Account: Enter your Registration Number and Password to access your individual marks.​

      • Download or Print Your Marks: Once logged in, you can view, download, or print your detailed marks for future reference.
